job.resolved_prompt:
### Use case(s) - what problem will this feature solve?

In some cases we want to retry connections more aggressively compared to the default behavior (e.g. for health checkers in tests in order to detect that server is up faster).

### Proposed Solution

Add tunable parameters as described in the [documentation](https://github.com/grpc/grpc/blob/master/doc/connection-backoff.md).

It can be done by extending `grpc.BackoffConfig` struct (and therefore is not a breaking change).

/bin/zsh -lc "find .. -name AGENTS.md -o -name PROJECT_BRIEF.md; sed -n '1,180p' backoff.go; sed -n '210,285p' dialoptions.go; sed -n '1,130p' internal/backoff/backoff.go; sed -n '920,1030p' clientconn.go; sed -n '800,875p' clientconn_test.go; sed -n '1,130p' doc/connection-backoff.md 2>/dev/null || true"

/bin/zsh -lc "git log -1 --format='%h %ad %s' --date=iso; git log --oneline -10; git remote -v; git branch -a --no-color | head -30"

/bin/zsh -lc "git log --all --oneline -- backoff.go internal/backoff/backoff.go | head -40; git show b03f6fd:internal/backoff/backoff.go | sed -n '35,100p'; git show b03f6fd:backoff.go | sed -n '25,60p'"
/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"backoff\\.Exponential|internal/backoff|MaxDelay\" --glob '*_test.go' internal clientconn_test.go | head -120; rg -n \"DefaultBackoffConfig\" --glob '*.go' ."
file_change
file_change
/bin/zsh -lc 'gofmt -w backoff.go dialoptions.go clientconn.go internal/backoff/backoff.go clientconn_test.go && git diff --check && go test ./internal/backoff .'

/bin/zsh -lc "git diff -- backoff.go internal/backoff/backoff.go dialoptions.go clientconn.go clientconn_test.go; find . -maxdepth 2 -type d -name vendor -o -name .scratch; go env GOPATH GOMODCACHE GOPROXY; rg -n \"func Test|func \\(.*\\) Test\" internal/backoff --glob '*_test.go' || true"

/bin/zsh -lc 'go test ./internal/backoff .'
